recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央有一個由呈渦旋狀排列、細胞質淡粉紅、核長橢圓的類上皮組織球組成的肉芽腫，外圍有小淋巴球環繞，周圍骨髓中可見漿細胞與嗜伊紅性球；中央沒有壞死，屬於非乾酪性肉芽腫（non-caseating granuloma）。
features: Well-formed granuloma of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, indistinct borders and elongated vesicular nuclei in a whorled arrangement
No central necrosis within the granuloma
Cuff of small mature lymphocytes around the epithelioid aggregate
Surrounding cellular marrow with plasma cells, eosinophils and hematopoietic elements
Adjacent fat spaces and a hemorrhagic edge; no multinucleated giant cells clearly identified in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a well-formed non-caseating granuloma composed of whorled epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated nuclei, surrounded by a rim of small mature lymphocytes. The adjacent marrow is cellular with a reactive admixture of plasma cells and eosinophils. No central necrosis, atypical large cells or organisms are evident on H&E. Findings are consistent with non-caseating granulomatous inflammation; given negative infectious workup, an association with systemic inflammatory disease (here, Crohn disease) is plausible.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas often show central caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells, and require AFB stain, culture or PCR for exclusion even when non-caseating.
Sarcoid granulomas are morphologically identical, so separation relies on clinical, radiologic and serum ACE findings.
A search for CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in the surrounding polymorphous infiltrate is required.
Drug-related granulomas are usually small, loose and eosinophil-rich, with temporal association to a drug.
